lineage.event_skipped_degraded: Skipped — AI review was not available on this scan
lineage.evidence_skipped_degraded: Skipped — AI review was not available
lineage.notFound: We could not load that finding.
lineage.reason_absent: The code is no longer where this points.
lineage.reason_ambiguous: The code appears in several places in the file, so we could not tell which one this is.
lineage.reason_error: The check failed with an error.
lineage.reason_exact: The code is still there, exactly as recorded.
lineage.reason_file_gone: The code is gone from the file.
lineage.reason_file_missing: The file is no longer in the codebase.
lineage.reason_found_elsewhere: The code is still in the file, but on a different line.
lineage.reason_near_miss: Similar code is there, but not an exact match — it may have been edited.
lineage.reason_no_protocol: This scanner is too old to re-read the code and check.
lineage.reason_no_quote: We have no saved excerpt of the original code to look for.
lineage.reason_no_path: The finding records no file to re-check.
lineage.reason_not_a_file: The path points at a folder, not a file, so it could not be re-checked.
lineage.reason_not_checked: The scan did not check this finding.
lineage.reason_other_mount: This was first reported from a different copy of the codebase, so this scan could not check it.
lineage.reason_outside_root: The recorded path is outside the scanned folder, so it was not read.
lineage.reason_outside: This scan started below this file and never looked at it.
lineage.reason_oversize: The file is too large to re-read, so this could not be checked.
lineage.reason_pruned: The scan did not look inside {{detail}}.
lineage.reason_returned: The code came back after this was reported fixed.
lineage.reason_truncated: The scan stopped before it had listed every file, so it did not look everywhere.
lineage.reason_unknown: The scan could not settle this either way.
lineage.reason_unquoted: The saved excerpt is too short or too long to search for reliably.
lineage.reason_unreadable: The file could not be read on this scan.
lineage.statusHint_accepted_risk: A person decided to keep this, knowing the risk.
lineage.statusHint_false_positive: A person rejected this — it is not a real problem.
lineage.statusHint_fixed: A scan re-read the code and the problem is gone.
lineage.statusHint_open: Reported and still there. Nobody has picked it up yet.
lineage.statusHint_regression: This was closed once and has come back.
lineage.statusHint_unconfirmed: The last scan could not re-find this, but the code it points at has not changed. Treat it as still open until someone checks.
